gloss: leaving one's job on getting married

definitions.gloss: leaving one's job on getting married
definitions.explanation: Quitting a job because one is getting married. The word belongs to a time when women were expected to leave work at marriage, and it now sounds dated; it is still used, often lightly, of anyone who leaves work on marrying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寿退社|ことぶきたいしゃ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She left the company to get married.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寿退社|ことぶきたいしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧だった。
examples.english: In the past, leaving work on marriage was the norm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}ける⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{寿退社|ことぶきたいしゃ}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧⟦{聞|き}かなく→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Now many people keep working after they marry, and one rarely hears the word kotobuki taisha anymore.

notes:
Composed of {寿|ことぶき} (celebration, congratulations) + ⟦{退社|たいしゃ}→退社：06156_taisha⟧ (leaving a company). Usually said of women, reflecting the custom it names; take care, since some people find it old-fashioned or loaded.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寿退社|ことぶきたいしゃ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave one's job to get married
- {寿退社|ことぶきたいしゃ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{辞|や}める: to quit on getting married

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧: leaving one's job; retirement
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧: marriage
